Container.Name: TautWeekly for Plex
Container.ExtraParams: --read-only --publish 127.0.0.1:8787:8080/tcp --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=256m,mode=1777 --tmpfs /run:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m,mode=0755 --stop-timeout 1800 --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --cap-drop ALL --cap-add CHOWN --cap-add DAC_OVERRIDE --cap-add FOWNER --cap-add SETGID --cap-add SETUID
Container.Overview: Generate preview-first weekly Plex activity newsletters using Tautulli. The authenticated TautWeekly Manager recovery endpoint is fixed to Unraid loopback port 8787; use an SSH local forward for initial setup and recovery, then optional public HTTPS access only through Tailscale Funnel. After installation, retrieve the one-time pairing token from the container Console with: /opt/tautweekly/bin/run-as-user.sh /opt/tautweekly/bin/tautweekly-manager access-bootstrap --data-dir /data/manager. The pairing token is never written to logs. Unraid owns container lifecycle and stable image updates.
Container.Description: TautWeekly for Plex generates activity, welcome, quiet-week, and milestone email newsletters. Configuration, Manager credentials, state, backups, and generated output stay in private appdata. Manager authentication is mandatory and scheduling is disabled by default. Optional Tailscale Funnel uses bundled official binaries in userspace mode, separate root-only state, explicit interactive sign-in, and no auth key, Docker socket, privileged mode, host executable, router port, or firewall change.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Tautulli Plex newsletter email activity digest
Container.Requires: A reachable Tautulli server and an SMTP STARTTLS account. Optional public remote access also requires a separately created Tailscale account and explicit interactive sign-in; remote viewers need only an ordinary HTTPS browser and the Manager password.
Container.Changes: 2026-08-31: Added optional public HTTPS access through a fixed-target Tailscale Funnel adapter with explicit sign-in and root-only provider state. 2026-08-26: Selected the unified image's explicit Unraid profile while preserving appdata, Manager authentication, hardening, scheduling, health, and Apps-owned updates.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Private configuration, Manager credentials, state, backups, logs, assets, and generated previews. Preserve this path across updates and reinstalls.

Config.Name: Tailscale state
Config.Description: Root-only state for the optional official Tailscale userspace runtime. Keep separate from /data; never share, inspect, or back it up as ordinary Manager data.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used by the weekly scheduler, for example America/Phoenix.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Non-root Unraid user ID used for appdata ownership.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Non-root Unraid group ID used for appdata ownership.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Restrictive file-creation mask for configuration and output.

Config.Name: Runtime profile
Config.Description: Validated unified-image behavior profile. Keep unraid for this template.

Config.Name: Public Funnel adapter
Config.Description: Set to enabled only to start the isolated official Tailscale userspace runtime. Then use the container Console command /opt/tautweekly/bin/tautweekly-funnel login; auth keys and tokens are refused.

Config.Name: Preview Base URL
Config.Description: Leave empty for loopback recovery. The Manager supplies its independently verified Funnel URL when public access is Active.

Config.Name: Manager Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Leave empty for loopback recovery. The exact active Funnel hostname is admitted automatically after backend verification; schemes, paths, ports, and wildcards are refused.

Config.Name: Secure Manager Cookies
Config.Description: Leave false for loopback HTTP recovery. Verified Funnel requests receive the public HTTPS cookie boundary automatically.

Config.Name: Package Kind
Config.Description: Identifies the Unraid-owned update path to the Manager. Keep this at the value supplied by Community Apps.

Config.Name: Host Adapter API
Config.Description: Package compatibility marker used to detect an older saved Unraid template. Keep this at the value supplied by the current Community Apps template.
